Review DigitalOcean?

Reviewers describe DigitalOcean as a simple, dependable cloud host that suits developers, solo founders, and small teams. The most consistent praise is for straightforward setup, predictable pricing, clear documentation, easy droplet management, solid Python/Flask support, and reliable performance. Support also gets strong marks. Founder feedback from the makers of RankSpot, Sheet Ninja, and Harbor echoes that theme, saying it avoids the cost and infrastructure complexity they associate with larger clouds. The only notable caveat is one mention of a “disastrous commercial policy.”
